summary: Marlon Duran's campaign frames the Free Palestine struggle as analogous to South Africa's anti-apartheid movement and the indigenous-rights fight in South Texas, calling for international law and human dignity to govern policy. On March 14, 2026, he pledged to never accept money from AIPAC or any PAC. The platform embeds Palestinian justice within a broader anti-oppression framework grounded in principle rather than specific legislative provisions.
